blog.para1: A cursed wish with no refund policy. A boxing coach who won't take your vote on when the round ends. Some doors only open one way.

films.title: Coyote vs. Acme (2026)
films.hook: The movie blog is live and this week Wile E. Coyote taught me more about showing up for the grind than most training montages ever have.
films.excerpt: Coyote never actually catches the Roadrunner and never really wants to, not deep down. He just wants the process. There's something in that which felt oddly familiar by the end of this particular week, showing up for the grind and quietly enjoying it despite yourself.

films.title: Obsession (2025)
films.hook: The movie blog is live and this week's deep dive is about a wish with a customer service line and no refunds, which is basically what round six feels like.
films.excerpt: Bear wants this to end, but he can't take his wish back, and that single fact turns the second half of the film into a countdown with exactly one door out. Once the mitts are up and round one starts, that guy is gone. There's no line you call to renegotiate the terms.
